verdict.rationale: Stable has a real API (x-api-key auth) covering MailItem search and retrieval, Location creation and onboarding, and company create/list/deactivate. But its own docs scope it narrowly with "Currently the API supports searching for and retrieving MailItems, as well as creating new Locations," and webhooks and API keys are managed only in the dashboard. Missing for 10: API endpoints for the UI mail actions (scan, ship/forward, shred, check deposit), tagging, routing rules, team/user assignment, roles and permissions, webhook and API-key management, and a published OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Currently the API supports searching for and retrieving **MailItems**, as well as creating new **Locations** and onboarding them via the USPS Form 1583.
You can configure webhook endpoints via the Stable Dashboard.
You can create and manage your own API keys directly in the dashboard under Settings > API keys
